enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains sleeping. Turns to right side. Moves arm under pillow. Continues sleeping. Lies on back. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies soap. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast while checking the news on Phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Places eggs on counter. Takes out frying pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Places eggs on plate. Makes toast. Pours milk into glass. Picks up phone. Reads news. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Places dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing the work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Opens closet. Takes out shirt and pants. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Opens drawer. Takes out socks. Puts on socks. Takes out work bag. Places laptop in bag. Places notebook in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Gets up. Walks to exit. Exits bus. Walks to office building. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Discusses program plans. Returns to desk. Makes phone call. Coordinates with volunteers. Prepares materials. Prints documents. Files documents. Organizes files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to lunch place. Enters restaurant. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Unwraps food. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Checks phone. Wipes mouth. Throws trash. Exits restaurant. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Back at the office, running program planning meetings and preparing community event materials
enriched_activities.desc: Enters office. Sits at desk. Opens computer. Reviews agenda. Calls meeting to order. Presents plan. Listens to feedback. Takes notes. Assigns tasks. Adjourns meeting. Gathers materials. Cuts paper. Glues items. Prints flyers. Stacks flyers. Packs materials into box.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Gets up. Walks to exit. Exits bus. Walks home. Opens door. Enters home.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Takes out cutting board. Cuts vegetables. Cuts chicken. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil. Adds chicken. Stirs. Adds vegetables. Cooks. Turns off stove. Places food on plate.

Sits at table. Picks up fork. Cuts chicken. Eats chicken. Eats vegetables. Drinks water. Picks up napkin. Wipes mouth. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Places fork on plate. Stands up. Picks up plate. Carries plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies soap. Scrubs plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in dishwasher. Scrubs glass. Rinses glass. Places glass in dishwasher. Turns off tap. Closes dishwasher. Presses start button.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Leans back. Puts feet on coffee table. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Changes channel. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Returns with snack. Sits down. Eats snack. Watches TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using Computer at the desk for personal emails and planning the next day's program tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads personal emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Plans next day's tasks. Types notes. Saves file. Closes email. Opens document. Edits document. Saves document. Turns off computer. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts toothbrush down. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with Phone, reading and preparing for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks social media. Scrolls. Puts phone down. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Picks up phone. Sets alarm. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Lies down. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Remains sleeping. Turns to other side. Moves arm. Continues sleeping. Lies on back. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep.
